root_cause: Instantly had no production integration boundary or durable attribution/event model. The API v2 secret remains absent, so all delivery and provider operations are deliberately fail-closed.
completed: Added a fail-closed Instantly API v2 client and explicit feature flags
Added lean durable Instantly staging, event, status, and product-attribution records
Added idempotent signed webhook normalization and canonical external-outreach reconciliation
Added first-party attribution for Free First Award start, report generation, and paid subscription
Added founder-safe Instantly System Health status with outbound and auto-handoff disabled
limitations: The external Instantly API v2 key is absent. API reads/writes, actual CRM staging, campaign mapping discovery, webhook registration, and live reconciliation remain intentionally disabled until the one required credential is stored securely.
